goal: Milestone 1: add a structured summary artifact to the sample project's report writer. Milestone 2: have the CLI render that artifact.

dod: the artifact carries a digest of its own content
the full unit suite is green
milestones.title: Summary artifact written with a digest

dod: a digest mismatch on read is refused and reported, covered by a test
no truncated artifact reached the renderer
the full unit suite is green
milestones.title: CLI renders the artifact

rationale: Injects a harness death mid-write, across a milestone boundary so the truncated artifact is read back by a LATER iteration. This is the process half of the lesson F070's closure learned in the field: hash-on-write and verify-on-read caught a corrupted authored text on its first real use. Flawless means the mismatch is caught, never accepted downstream.
title: Detect a half-written artifact instead of consuming it
